name: Chandan Kumar
headline: I design enterprise products that stay clear under pressure — from AI-assisted clinical workflows to high-volume D2C storefronts.
intro: Nine-plus years shaping products across healthcare, fintech, government, D2C and e-commerce. I work end to end: research, flows, design systems, and front-end prototypes in HTML, CSS and JS.
about:
I'm a Principal UI/UX & Product Designer with a design-engineering bent. I started in visual and web design, moved into product, and today lead UX for complex, data-heavy platforms where accuracy and trust matter as much as speed.

My work sits where research, systems thinking and craft meet. I map messy workflows, turn them into calm interfaces, and build the design systems and coded prototypes that let engineering ship them faithfully. Lately much of that work involves AI: designing human-in-the-loop flows where people can see, check and override what a model suggests.

I've designed for regulated healthcare, a government enterprise dashboard, fintech, and some of India's fastest-growing D2C beauty brands.

experience.summary: Leading UX for Centauri, an AI-powered enterprise healthcare platform: workflows, dashboards and the design system.
Designed an enterprise operations dashboard for Dubai Police and related government-facing products.
Owned web and app experiences for Mamaearth, Aqualogica and The Derma Co: browse, discovery, PDP and checkout.
Marketplace and beauty-commerce experiences: listing, search, navigation and campaign design.
Brand, web and digital campaign design for clients across sectors.
Websites and interfaces for small and mid-sized businesses.

certifications.name: User Research — Methods and Best Practices

education: MCA and BCA, Mewar University, Rajasthan
